DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia (Physiologic Jaundice)

The lab results show a total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL with a normal direct bilirubin of 0.7 mg/dL, which is consistent with the unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia seen in newborn jaundice. This finding rules out biliary obstruction and supports a diagnosis of neonatal jaundice rather than the acute abdominal infection suggested by the other text. I will now assess for signs of kernicterus and review the baby's feeding history to determine if phototherapy is required.
